senses.gloss: m. (<he>ת־רגל</he> with anorganic <cite ref="N00001"><he>נ</he></cite>, as <cite ref="V00964"><he>תְּרוּנְגָּא</he></cite> for <cite ref="V00956"><he>תְּרוֹגָא</he></cite>; v.
units: Targ. Prov. XXX, 31) [spurred,] cock, chicken.
<cite ref="Yoma 21a:2">Yoma 21ᵃ</cite> <he>ת׳ בינוני</he> a normal cock (that crows neither too early nor too late).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 63b:16">Ib. 63ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="N01262"><he>נֵרְגַל</he></cite>. Tanḥ. Emor 2; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 139:5">Yalk. Sam. 139</cite> <he>אין כאן ת׳ שיקרא</he> is there no cock here to crow (announcing the morning)? <cite ref="Bava Metzia 86b:6">B. Mets. 86ᵇ</cite> <he>מובחר שבעופות ת׳</he> (some ed. <cite ref="V01024"><he>תרנגולת</he></cite>) the choice of fowls is the chicken.
Bekh. 8ᵃ (of the hen); a. fr.—Pl. תַּרְנְגוֹלִים, תַּרְנְגוֹלִין. B. Mets. l. c. Tanḥ. l. c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 7:7">B. Kam. VII, 7</cite> <he>אין מגדלין ת׳ וכ׳</he> no chickens were raised in Jerusalem.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 3:5:4">Y. Ber. III, 6ᵈ</cite> top <he>אדומים</he> (<he>ת׳</he>) red cocks.

<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 1:5">Ab. Zar. I, 5</cite> <he>מותר … תרנגול לבן בין הת׳</he> you may sell him (the gentile) a white cock along with other cocks (although he may use the white cock for idolatrous purposes).
Yeb. 84ᵃ כת׳ של בית בוקיא like the cocks of B. B. (that tolerate no intruder); a. fr.—[Y. Dem. II, 22ᵈ top תרנגול קיסריין, v. תַּרְנְגוֹלָא II.]—Fem. תַּרְנְגוֹלֶת hen.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 63b:16">Snh. 63ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <he>סכות בנות</he>, <cite ref="II Kings 17:30">II Kings XVII, 30</cite>) <he>מאי ניהו ת׳</he> what is this (deity)? A hen.

<cite ref="Shabbat 67b:5">Sabb. 67ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="C00136"><he>גַּבְרִית</he></cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 6:5">Tosef. ib. VI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 8:5">VIII</cite>), 5; a. fr.
